text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Teio, Teio! Do you know what today is?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Today? Is it the bargain sale day for 
carrot bread?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Nooo! That's totally wrong! The hint is 
Turbo!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Today's the day Turbo's gonna treat me 
to carrot bread!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
No, no, no~! Why does Turbo have to be the 
one treating?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Then... how about a day where Turbo gives 
me a shoulder massage!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
That's not fair! Teio, you've been the 
only one getting all the good stuff this 
whole time!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, just kidding. Happy birthday, 
Turbo.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Geez, I told you that's not it~!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: ...Ah?! No, it isn't! I'm totally right!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I guessed it right, so why are you mad at 
me...?
